pages.text: Plug in a controller and $(bold)Controlify$() takes over: on-screen button hints, a cursor for menus, an on-screen keyboard for text. Xbox, PlayStation, Switch and Steam Deck are recognised and labelled.$(br2)$(bold)Sticks$() move and look. $(bold)Right trigger$() attacks, $(bold)left trigger$() uses. $(bold)A$() jumps, $(bold)Y$() inventory, $(bold)X$() swaps hands.

$(li)$(bold)Bumpers:$() hotbar$(li)$(bold)Click left stick:$() sprint; $(bold)right stick:$() sneak$(li)$(bold)Start:$() pause; $(bold)Select:$() camera$(li)$(bold)B:$() backpack (the pack's bind)$(li)$(bold)D-pad:$() up chat, down drop, left the atlas (the pack's bind), right the $(bold)radial menu$()

The radial menu starts empty and is yours to fill: Options, Controls, Controller Settings, Radial Menu. Good picks: Recruits command screen, place a pin, zoom, dog whistle, quiver, player list.$(br2)Ships, airships and wagons steer with the sticks like walking.
